newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria executes six for robbery, child kidnapping.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria executes six for robbery, child kidnapping.

text.p: Six people found guilty of robbery and child kidnapping by a special military tribunal were executed by firing squad in the eastern Nigerian town of Owerri on Thursday, witnesses and residents said.
"The six persons were executed this (Thursday) afternoon and thousands of people watched the incident," resident Valentine Anyanwu told Reuters by telephone from there.
The six, including the son of a prominent Owerri businessman, were linked to several robberies and killings, which included children in the town in September.
The killings, which residents believed were for ritual purposes, sparked riots in Owerri at the time.

Nigeria's military government, strongly criticised by Western countries for alleged human rights abuses and lack of democracy, has maintained that executing robbers was the only way to stem violent crime rampant in cities.
